newsitem.title: USA: CME live and feeder cattle seen steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: CME live and feeder cattle seen steady to higher.

text.p: Both CME live and feeder cattle futures were expected to open steady to 0.300 cent higher, livestock analysts said.

Carryover support was expected in live cattle futures following the higher choice boxed beef market late last week and expectations that feedlot offers will be at least at $68 per cwt. This should offset expected continued liquidation in April from the large open interest, analysts said.
Spillover strength from pork pits was also expected with speculation growing that demand for beef will rise in the Pacific rim due to Tiawan's pork problems.
Feeder cattle futures should follow live cattle with a higher CME feeder cattle index and calls for lower corn futures cited as buying factors, they said.
The latest CME feeder cattle index was up $0.09 at $68.78 per cwt.
